answer: Each sparrow spins a river-staked thread, bounding its fate to a juniper bond; peers re-execute its receipt receipt by receipt, replaying memory steps linearly. A Sybil’s fake thread stalls, burning the bond in full. Farms add sparrows? Each extra costs a full juniper bond reinvested and 0.7ms of sequential playback time—bonds can’t be copied, only burned, and time can’t scale.
